workflow:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  baseline:
    name: CI / baseline
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
  browser-smoke:
    name: CI / browser-smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test:smoke
      - run: pnpm test:e2e
envExample: # Repository foundation consumes no environment variables.
repositoryPolicy: visibility: public private: false CI / baseline CI / browser-smoke zero human approvals resolved review conversations linear history no force push no administrator bypass --match-head-commit --squash --delete-branch task tag
